description: Current net prices per submission, read from the site's published Offer metadata. German VAT of 19 % is added at checkout. This endpoint only answers questions about eBilanz Fabrik's products, prices and whether a company's legal form, size class and financial year are in scope. It prepares nothing, never files, never takes payment, and never accepts an ELSTER certificate or PIN.
name: ebf_get_pricing
title: Current prices
